properties.name: Laurel Creek Covered Bridge
properties.short: 1910 covered bridge over Laurel Creek at Lillydale, among the shortest historic spans in the state.

properties.name: Indian Creek Covered Bridge
properties.short: ca. 1898 Howe-truss covered bridge over Indian Creek near Salt Sulphur Springs.

properties.name: Hokes Mill Covered Bridge
properties.short: ca. 1899 Long-truss covered bridge over Second Creek near Lewisburg.
